steps.eval: controller.addNote('character', 'Wren Aldous', 'Admiralty cartographer, thirty-four. Measures the coast every spring and calls it mourning. Copies everything exactly as it is written.')
controller.addNote('character', 'Captain Ilse Varga', 'Daughter of the missing keeper. Wet coat, no patience. Knows more about the Ember than she says.')
controller.addNote('character', 'Tomas Varga', 'Keeper of the Ember until the night he vanished, eleven years ago. Kept the ledger. Aimed the lens out to sea.')
controller.addNote('place', 'Harrowgate', 'Fishing town on a shrinking headland. Tide goes out all at once. Lodgings above the chandler’s.')
controller.addNote('place', 'The Ember', 'The lighthouse at the end of the sea wall. 112 steps. Its lamp turns ember-red in fog.')
controller.addNote('research', 'Fresnel lenses', 'A first-order lens weighs several tonnes and turns on a bath of mercury, so a keeper could aim it by hand.')
